_note: Copy this file to report_config.json and fill in your telemetry endpoint to enable the (still opt-in, off-by-default) anonymous draft reporting. The endpoint is the Cloudflare Worker from the telemetry setup; report_key is its X-Report-Key secret. Never commit a filled-in report_config.json — it is listed in .gitignore. Without this file the reporting feature does not exist in the app at all.
